game.title: Ultima I: The First Age of Darkness (DOS)

shots.caption: Text title: Ultima I, The First Age of Darkness, Copyright 1987 Origin
Origin Systems logo, drawn line by line in the attract loop
Origin Systems Presents...
Attract text: a new release of the best selling role-playing adventure
Attract text: Lord British's original fantasy masterpiece
Ultima I: castle title picture
Credits card after a key: trademarks, Conversion by John Fachini
Main menu: a) Generate new character, b) Continue previous game
Character Generation: 30 points to distribute over six statistics
Strength raised to 20, Agility rising: 16 points left
All 30 points spent: Str 20 Agi 18 Sta 17 Cha 13 Wis 10 Int 12
Select thy race: Human, Elf, Dwarf, Bobbit
Human chosen (Intelligence +5): select thy sex
Select thy class: Fighter, Cleric, Wizard, Thief
Fighter (Strength and Agility +10): Enter thy name: ryz
Save this character? (Y-N)
Another build: female Bobbit wizard (Str -5, Wis +10, Int +10)
Character Selection: 1) ryz, slots 2-4 empty
ryz on the overworld east of the Castle of Lord British
Status panel (Hits, Food, Exp., Coin) and the four-line message log
Ztats: ryz, level 1 male human fighter, leather armour, two daggers
Ready weapon: a) Hands, b) Dagger
Ready armour: a) Skin, b) Leather armor
Inform and search: You are in the lands of Lord British
Cast Prayer outdoors: "POTENTIS-LAUDIS!" Hmmmm... no effect!
Noise off, Noise on: the sound toggle
Commands without a target: HyperJump?, Huh?, Steal?
Hit the Orc! 17 damage; Orc attacks! Hit! 2 damage
Killed the Orc! 2 copper! 1 silver! (Exp. 3, Coin 112)
Mount Horse: ryz rides the horse
Riding east on the horse
X-it: ryz dismounts, the horse stays behind
Quit - saving game...saved. (outdoors only; play continues)
Food runs out: ryz, thou art dead
ryz, thou art dead: lift-off without fuel
Resurrected: 99 hits and food, no experience or coin
The city of Britian: transport, magic, pub, armour, weapons and food shops
Scooter's Super Duper Transport: horse, cart, raft, frigate
Horse bought for 36 pence: Sold!
Selling to the transport shop: Sorry, we don't deal in used stuff
The Armour Shop of Lord Eldric D'Charbonneux: leather, chain, plate
Plate mail for 135 with 100 pence: Thou canst not afford it!
Britian's weapon shop: mace 8, rope and spikes 19
Selling weapons: the dagger fetches 1 pence
Mad Chad's Magic Shoppe: Open 5, Magic Missile 15, Ladder Down 25
Li'l Karelia's Finnish Grocery: packs of 10 food for 5 pence each
20 packs of food bought: Food 400, Coin 90
Pub de Varg: Here, have a cold one! (ale for 1 pence)
Tavern keeper: 20 enemy vessels make a space ace
Tavern keeper: the princess's reward and a gift for an 8th level ace
Tavern keeper: Mondain's evil gem made him immortal
Tavern keeper: many lakes and ponds have strong magical powers
Steal behind the armour counter: Thou dost find a Reflect suit
Drop pence: 10 dropped in town (OK!)
Steal with the alarm raised: Oh no! Thou wert caught!
The Castle of Lord British: halls, pools, the king's room and the prison
Lord British: Dost thou offer pence or service?
50 pence offered: In return I give unto thee 75 hit points
Lord British: Go forth and find The Grave of the Lost Soul
Service asked again: Thou art on a quest for me already!
The jester killed: Hit Jester! Killed! Thou hast found a key!
The key unlocks a prison cell: The door is open!
The castle guards turn hostile: Attacked by guard! Hit!...7 damage!
The Castle of the Lost King: mess hall, stables, prison, F W A shops
The Lost King: Go now and kill a Gelatinous Cube
Quest done: all four gems launch a time machine; a red gem
The Tower of Knowledge on the overworld, a landmark beside a lake
Pillars of Protection: You feel a strong magic surrounding you!
Tower of Knowledge: TURIS-SCIENTIA-MAGNOPERE; 2 Intelligence
Pillars of the Argonauts: FORTES FORTUNA ADIUVAT! You find a Mace!
Pillar of Ozymandias: the sonnet on a pedestal; 1 Wisdom
The Sign Post: ULTIMA THULE! The sky grows dark; 2 Stamina
The Southern Sign Post: OMNIA MUTANTUR! 2 Charisma
The Eastern Sign Post: GO EAST TO GO EAST!
Grave of the Lost Soul on a quest: VAE VICTIS, quest completed
After the grave: A quest has been completed! Thou dost gain 2 Stamina
Lord British: Thou hast completed thy quest; 8 points of strength
Ztats mid-game: level 5, sword readied, spells, More on page 2
Ready spell: the spells bought so far, letters fixed per spell
The lands of Lord British: mountains, a lake, the town of Grey
The lands of the Feudal Lords: forest ridge and mountains
The lands of the Dark Unknown: two towns and a castle
The lands of Danger and Despair
Inform in the forest: You are in the woods
On foot at the shore: You can't walk on water!
Mountains are impassable!
Mount Cart: travelling east by cart
Board Raft: drifting out to sea
Board Frigate at the coast
On the frigate: Inform says You are at sea
At sea: Ness creature attacks! Hit! 8 damage
At sea: Giant squid attacks!
At sea: Dragon turtle attacks! Hit! 4 damage
Fire cannons: East. Killed the Pirate ship!
Board Aircar: flying east
Fire lasers: East. Killed the Orc!
Aircars can't pass woods!
Evil trent, a walking tree, attacks! Hit! 14 damage
Lands of the Feudal Lords: Knight attacks! Hit! 2 damage
Necromancer attacks! Hit! 6 damage
Wandering warlock attacks! Hit! 14 damage
Bear attacks! Hit! 2 damage
Dark knight attacks! Hit! 10 damage
Hidden archer attacks! The archer cannot be seen
Hood attacks! Hit! 2 damage
The city of Moon: second town plan, a pond and the grocery
The city of Fawn: third town plan, arms, inn and a green park
The city of Paws: six shops in a row above two ponds
The city of Montor: a round walled town with two counters
The city of Yew: pub, transport, armour and weapons
The city of Tune: a town inside a moat
The city of Grey: weapons, transport, inn and magic in the north
The Tempered Steel in Moon: dagger, axe, sword (even towns)
After 3,000 moves: Britian adds great sword, amulet and staff
Max's Armoury after 3,000 moves: vacuum suit and reflect suit
Mystic Melinda's in Moon: Unlock and Ladder Up
Stealing in Lord British's weaponry: Thou dost find a Light Sword
The Mines of Mt. Drash II, level 1: first-person wireframe corridor
Dungeon level 1: attacked by a Skeleton
Dungeon door ahead (doors are walked through)
Standing on a ladder down: the hole in the floor
K-limb down the ladder: level 2, a Ranger waits
Unlock chest: Thou hast set off a trap!
Unlock chest: Thou dost find gold
A coffin on the dungeon floor: Open coffin
Level 1: Attacked by Ranger! Missed!
Level 1: Thief stole a Dagger
Level 2: a Giant rat
Level 2: a Bat
Attack with sword: Hit! Spider killed! Thou dost find: 8 copper!
Level 3: a Viper
Level 4: a Cyclops
Level 4: the invisible Gelatinous cube: Armor destroyed!
Level 5: an Ettin hits for 105 damage
Level 5: Attacked by Mimic! The chest is a monster
Level 6: a Lizard man
Cast Magic Missile "VASTO!" Hit! Orc killed!
Level 6: the Minotaur
Level 7: a Carrion creeper
Level 7: a Tangler
Level 8: A gremlin stole some food!
Level 8: Wandering eyes
Level 9: a Wraith
Level 9: a Lich
Level 10: a Mind whipper
Level 10: a Zorn
Level 10: a Daemon
Level 10: the Balron, deepest of the dungeon monsters
Cast Ladder Down "INFERUS!": Ladder created!
Cast Ladder Up "ASCENDO!": Ladder created!
Cast Blink "DUCIS-EDUCO!": Teleported!
Cast Create "STRUXI!": a force field across the corridor
Cast Destroy "DELIO!": Field destroyed!
Cast Kill "INTERFICIO!" on level 9: Lich destroyed!
Cast Open "APERTUS!": Coffin opened! Thou dost find: 8 copper!
Cast Unlock "PECUNIA!": Chest opened! Thou dost find: 8 copper!
K-Limb up to level 0: out of the dungeon, hit points gained for kills
After 3,000 moves Scooter's adds the Aircar and the Shuttle
The shuttle bought in Britian, parked beside the town
Board Shuttle: the countdown 10..9..8..7..
Space, top view: Sosaria, the sun, a starbase and the shuttle
Sector Scan: the 7x7 sectors of space, H marks enemy craft
Front view: the starfield and the gun sight
HyperJump... Lightspeed! (only from the front view)
HyperJump completed: an enemy fighter in the new sector
View refused: Thou must eliminate all enemy craft first!
Fire! Hit!!! Thou art still a Space ace! (24 vessels)
Alien fires! A laser beam from the enemy fighter
The 20th vessel: Thou hast achieved the rank of Space Ace!
Thou hast landed safely! The shuttle back beside Britian
Ztats late: level 8, reflect suit, blaster, four gems
Late game: the cell unlocked, princess Julia free to follow ryz
Princess Julia saved: rewards and the time machine far to the northwest
The time machine on the overworld
Board Time Machine: four holes marked R G B W, the gems fit
Time machine, page 2: LAUNCH pressed, the journey through time begins
Time machine, page 3: a strong magic pulling thee from thy craft
Time machine, page 4: face to face with the evil Mondain himself
Mondain's chamber: the time machine, ryz, the gem and Mondain
Get (Gem): 2196 damage, The Gem is DESTROYED!
Hit Mondain! 51 damage! Mondain casts psionic shock
Mondain below 500 hit points turns into a bat
Mondain is dead! THOU ART VICTORIOUS!
Ending text: Lord British's reward, Press CONTROL-ALT-DEL to Restart
